baseline_models.focus_anchor: The oath joins الليل to the temporal verb أدبر.
baseline_models.mechanism: Night is selected not as a static span but at its rear edge: its darkness reaches its trailing remainder and passes away.

activation_trace.role: Night as darkness opposite day supplies the temporal field whose boundary is being marked.
The end and trailing remainder of a thing make the predicate a passing terminal phase.

changed_reading.before: An oath by night in general.
changed_reading.after: An oath by night precisely at its trailing, passing boundary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The inanimate الليل is made the subject of أدبر.
baseline_models.mechanism: The back and withdrawal branches turn a clock change into visible bodily motion: night presents its rear and leaves the scene.

activation_trace.role: The dark night is the actor receiving the motion predicate.
The rear or back gives the departure a spatially visible side.
Turning one's back and withdrawing animates night as an actor leaving.

changed_reading.before: أدبر merely reports that night ended.
changed_reading.after: Night is staged as an actor that turns its back and withdraws.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root د ب ر in أدبر carries branches of both the latter end and looking toward an outcome.
baseline_models.mechanism: The night is read from its consequence-facing edge: its recession matters because a transition is intelligible by what its end delivers.

activation_trace.role: The latter end and passing consequence orient attention beyond the night itself.
Managing by considering outcomes supplies an exploratory consequence-facing mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Night disappears as an automatic event.
changed_reading.after: Night's recession is viewed from the outcome to which its ending leads.

context_deltas.mechanism: Context separates kinds of retreat. The same back-turn belongs to the self-magnifying rejecter, later grows into turning aside and flight from reminder, while the night withdraws inside an orderly cosmic oath. Motion receives its value from what one withdraws from and what one's withdrawal makes way for.

activation_trace.role: Cosmic darkness supplies the nonhuman actor against which resistant human motion is compared.
Turning the back and withdrawing is the focus motion whose moral neutrality is tested by context.
The exact human back-turn anchors withdrawal to the preceding rejection sequence.
Self-greatness makes the human withdrawal an act of resistant elevation rather than simple departure.
Turning one's side away extends the surah's embodied vocabulary of evasion.
Flight and escape intensify evasive withdrawal into rapid departure from the reminder.

structural_cues: The deliberation and rejection sequence at 74:18-23 culminates in the exact focus verb أدبر.
The focus stands in the ordered celestial sequence 74:32-34, unlike the resistant human sequence.
At 74:49-51, turning away escalates into flight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the exact verbal echo, self-magnification, later turning-aside, and flight; I infer that their sequence contrasts evasive retreat with cosmic withdrawal that yields its place. A live alternative is that أدبر contributes only shared physical motion and transfers no ethical contrast.

changed_reading.after: The night becomes a control image showing that retreat is not intrinsically refusal: yielding departure differs from turning away from warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: Moonlight within darkness, the night's passing rear, and dawn's removal of a screen form a visibility relay. The focus is the moving hinge at which partial nocturnal visibility gives way to open disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Night's darkness establishes the concealed side of the visibility transition.
The trailing end of night supplies the hinge rather than a static dark state.
The moon and its sky-light provide visibility that is present but still belongs to night.
The first part of day names the state arriving across the focus boundary.
Removing a cover makes dawn's brightening function as disclosure.

structural_cues: 74:32, 74:33, and 74:34 are consecutive oath members: moon, withdrawing night, and unveiling dawn.
The focus uses إذ while the following parallel clause uses إذا, giving the paired transitions slightly different temporal presentations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered oath sequence and branches of darkness, moonlight, terminal passing, first day, and uncovering; I infer a single staged transfer of visibility. A live alternative is that the three oath objects are coordinate witnesses without a process linking them.

changed_reading.before: Night reaches its endpoint and disappears.
changed_reading.after: Night actively hands the scene from limited nocturnal light to dawn's uncovering.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening command to warn, the post-oath warning, and repeated naming of reminder turn the nightly transition into a renewable signal. Its recurrence supplies a warning that can be encountered again, not scenery exhausted after one viewing.

activation_trace.role: Warning that awakens caution establishes the surah's initiating task.
The recurring night supplies a repeatable environmental carrier for the warning.
Each passing end turns recurrence into a perceptible alert point.
The warning immediately after the oath explicitly assigns an alerting function to the sequence.
A reminder as something that reactivates memory extends warning into repeated recollection.

structural_cues: The surah begins with 'arise and warn' at 74:2.
The oath sequence is followed at 74:35-36 by 'one of the great' and 'a warning to humans.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning at the opening and after the oath plus the later reminder label; I infer that the recurrent nocturnal boundary functions as a daily alert. A live alternative is that the cosmic signs only certify the warning rather than themselves enacting it.

changed_reading.before: The verse offers one impressive cosmic witness.
changed_reading.after: The retreating night is a recurrent warning signal whose daily ending can reawaken attention.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus supplies rearward motion and a latter edge; the following application supplies advancing to the front or delaying behind. Together they create an orientation axis on which the observer must locate a response.

activation_trace.role: The back or rear gives the focus one pole of a spatial orientation.
The latter edge turns the same rearward image into temporal position.
Advancing forward supplies the opposed directional option offered to the addressee.
The rearward or delayed position converts cosmic backness into the human option of remaining behind.

structural_cues: The moon-night-dawn oath at 74:32-34 leads through warning at 74:36 directly to advance-or-delay at 74:37.
The paired verbs at 74:37 present opposed directions rather than a neutral middle position.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus's rear/end branches and the later forward/behind pair; I infer that the cosmic transition diagrams the addressee's orientation toward warning. A live alternative is that the motion metaphors remain separate and 74:37 applies only the warning generally.

changed_reading.before: The observer watches night move away.
changed_reading.after: Night's rearward passage becomes an orientation test asking whether the observer advances or remains behind.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah moves among materially different coverings: the opening outer wrap, nocturnal darkness that withdraws, dawn removing a screen, and final protective covering. The focus is the hinge that prevents all concealment from being treated alike: some cover is left behind, some is stripped for disclosure, and some preserves.

activation_trace.role: An outer covering worn over what is nearest the body opens the surah with material enclosure.
Night's darkness functions as the large-scale cover occupying the focus.
Withdrawal makes the nocturnal cover mobile and removable.
Removing a screen supplies the material action by which dawn succeeds the retreating cover.
Covering that protects distinguishes preservative concealment from a veil that must recede.

structural_cues: A wrapped figure opens the surah at 74:1, while protective covering closes it at 74:56.
The focus's dark phase is immediately followed by dawn's unveiling at 74:34.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outer wrapping, nocturnal darkness, withdrawal, uncovering, and protective covering; I infer a material economy that distinguishes enclosure, disclosure, and preservation. A live alternative is that these covers belong to unrelated constructions and should not be linked across the surah.

changed_reading.before: Night is darkness that happens to end.
changed_reading.after: Night is a removable cover within a larger discrimination between hiding, unveiling, and protective covering.

context_deltas.mechanism: The rejecter's inward deliberation and repeated estimation culminate in his turning back. That sequence activates the outcome-management branch of د ب ر at the focus, making night's dependable passage a counterpoint to calculation whose chosen outcome is refusal.

activation_trace.role: The heart's repeated consideration begins a deliberately constructed human sequence.
Estimating and managing by measure supplies the sequence's calculated procedure.
Outcome-oriented management on the culminating root links the plan to the withdrawal it produces.
The same outcome-facing branch makes the focus available as an ordered, consequence-bearing passage.
The night reaching its latter end grounds the exploratory management image in an actual terminal transition.

structural_cues: 74:18 begins 'he thought and estimated,' 74:19-20 repeat the estimation, and 74:23 ends the sequence with أدبر.
74:33 repeats أدبر inside a regular cosmic transition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the deliberation-estimation-withdrawal chain and the د ب ر branch of managing by outcomes; I infer a contrast between failed human estimation and dependable cosmic succession. A live alternative is that B006 is derivationally distant here and both occurrences of أدبر mean only turning away.

changed_reading.before: Night's outcome-facing end is only an abstract lexical possibility.
changed_reading.after: The context makes night an exploratory counter-model of ordered outcome against human calculation that ends in refusal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the manumission-after-death branch belongs to a legal derivative and أدبر does not itself mean 'release.' It remains worth carrying because that branch is attached to the focus root and 74:38 supplies a soul held as a pledge. Render only as a legal-material analogy of deferred release at a terminal boundary, not as a translation or a settled eschatological claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أدبر activates the د ب ر branch of manumission appointed after an owner's death.

activation_trace.role: Release deferred until a terminal event supplies the outlier's legal timing structure.
A document or thing held against a right supplies the state from which release would matter.

changed_reading.before: The end of night only removes darkness.
changed_reading.after: The terminal withdrawal of night faintly images a held condition reaching its appointed release point.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because Aldebaran is a proper-name branch distant from the verbal sense of أدبر. It remains anchored through the focus root, the explicit night, and the immediately preceding moon. Render as a secondary celestial-following resonance only; do not identify the retreating night with Aldebaran or replace the ordinary withdrawal reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The night setting and focus root د ب ر meet the branch naming Aldebaran as follower of the Pleiades.

activation_trace.role: Night and its darkness provide the literal sky setting for a stellar resonance.
Aldebaran following the Pleiades supplies a named celestial image of ordered following.
The moon and its light make the adjacent context explicitly celestial rather than merely temporal.

changed_reading.before: Night withdraws as one undifferentiated mass.
changed_reading.after: A faint stellar layer makes the oath evoke ordered celestial following within the departing night.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus form ordinarily depicts retreat, while cutting off the last remnant is a stronger branch and 74:28 describes another referent. It remains anchored in the focus root and is activated by the paired context images of no remainder and no leaving. Render as an intensity analogy for total nocturnal clearance, never as an equation of night with the destructive agent in 74:28.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The د ب ر branch of cutting off a final trace sharpens what أدبر could make imaginable at night's edge.

activation_trace.role: Cutting off a last remnant turns recession into the stronger image of trace-erasure.
What remains of a thing supplies the residue whose absence marks totality.
Leaving a thing supplies the paired possibility explicitly denied in the context.

changed_reading.before: Night recedes while traces may linger.
changed_reading.after: The context activates an extreme image in which the nocturnal remainder is cleared without a trace.

strongest_changes: The exact human reuse of أدبر and later flight language make the focus distinguish yielding withdrawal from evasive retreat.
The moon-night-dawn sequence changes a terminal night into a staged relay from darkness and partial light to uncovering.
The warning, reminder, and advance-or-delay frame turns a recurring cosmic boundary into an orientation signal for response.
summary.what_was_special: A three-word cosmic oath became a hinge because the whole-surah packet repeated its exact motion in a human refusal sequence, surrounded it with opposing visibility states, and later translated backness into response choices. The branch inventory also kept legal release, stellar following, and last-remnant erasure available as contained exploratory resonances.
remaining_uncertainties: The contribution of the إذ/إذا alternation may be structural styling rather than a meaningful aspectual contrast.
The ethical contrast between human and cosmic withdrawal depends on sequence and may exceed what the shared verb alone carries.
The outcome-management, deferred-release, Aldebaran, and remnant-erasure branches are form-distant and must remain explicitly exploratory.
